id: 30_Confined Space Safety Quiz Test Your Safety Knowledge Confined Space Safety Quiz
title: 有限空间小测验
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/30_Confined Space Safety Quiz Test Your Safety Knowledge Confined Space Safety Quiz.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/30_Confined Space Safety Quiz Test Your Safety Knowledge Confined Space Safety Quiz/src.py

points.K1: 测验规则：十题八对才过
points.K2: 危害、通风、防护、进出、检测、救援
points.K5: 监护人：盯住人，启动救援
points.K8: 连续监测，发现有毒气体

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个打开的井口旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands next to an open manhole and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 受限空间小测验，来试一试！

shots.scene: 厂区一个地下水池的检修口
shots.prompt_en: The access hatch of an underground water tank at a plant. No people.
shots.narration: 厂区地下水池要检修。

shots.scene: 阿杰坐在电脑前，老李站在旁边
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a computer while the facility engineer stands beside him.
shots.narration: 老李让阿杰先做一套受限空间测验。

shots.section_title: 危害、通风、防护、进出、检测、救援
shots.scene: 网页目录图标：危害、通风、防护用品
shots.prompt_en: Menu icons: a hazard sign, a fan and protective gear. No people.
shots.narration: 先读要点：了解常见危害，保证通风，
overlay: 危害、通风、防护、进出、检测、救援

shots.section_title: 危害、通风、防护、进出、检测、救援
shots.scene: 进出梯子、气体检测仪、救援三脚架图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an entry ladder, a gas detector and a rescue tripod. No people.
shots.narration: 配防护用品，按程序进出，监测气体，

shots.section_title: 危害、通风、防护、进出、检测、救援
shots.scene: 应急计划和培训课堂图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank emergency plan and a training class. No people.
shots.narration: 制定应急救援计划，做好培训。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 屏幕上十格进度条和倒计时
shots.prompt_en: A screen with a ten-segment progress bar and a countdown timer. No people.
shots.narration: 测验十题，限时十分钟。
overlay: 测验规则：十题八对才过

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 上一题按钮亮起
shots.prompt_en: A back button lights up on the screen. No people.
shots.narration: 觉得前面选错了，可以返回改。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 阿杰随手点选，结果页一绿九红
shots.prompt_en: The young male student clicks at random; the result screen shows one green and nine red boxes.
shots.narration: 阿杰随手答完，只得了10%。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 进度条在八成处插一面小旗
shots.prompt_en: A progress bar with a flag at four fifths. No people.
shots.narration: 要答对八题、达到80%才能通过。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 结果页每题标出正确答案，旁边重做按钮
shots.prompt_en: The result screen marks the correct answer for each question, with a restart button. No people.
shots.narration: 结果页标出每题正确答案，可以重做。

shots.scene: 救援三脚架和一队人练习
shots.prompt_en: A rescue tripod with a team of person icons practicing. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：救援演练什么时候做？

shots.scene: 定期、一年一次、新人加入三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a repeating calendar, a single yearly mark and a new worker icon. No people.
shots.narration: 定期做？一年一次？只在新人加入时？

shots.scene: 定期图标亮绿
shots.prompt_en: The repeating calendar icon lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：定期做，让工人熟悉救援程序。

shots.scene: 检测仪屏幕上几种气体图标
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector display with several gas icons. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：有毒物质最大允许接触限值？

shots.scene: 三张选项卡片
shots.prompt_en: Three option cards with icons. No people.
shots.narration: 因物质而异？始终低于50 ppm？没上限？

shots.scene: 第一张卡片亮绿
shots.prompt_en: The first card lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：因物质而异。

shots.section_title: 监护人：盯住人，启动救援
shots.scene: 监护人站在井口
shots.prompt_en: An attendant stands at the manhole with a radio.
shots.narration: 第五题：授权监护人的职责是什么？
overlay: 监护人：盯住人，启动救援

shots.section_title: 监护人：盯住人，启动救援
shots.scene: 监视并救援、远处监督、进去帮忙三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: watching and calling for rescue, supervising from far away and climbing in to help. No people.
shots.narration: 监视并启动救援？远处监督？进去帮忙？

shots.section_title: 监护人：盯住人，启动救援
shots.scene: 第一张卡片亮绿
shots.prompt_en: The first card lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：监视进入人员，紧急时启动救援。

shots.scene: 空白进入许可证
shots.prompt_en: A blank entry permit form. No people.
shots.narration: 第七题：谁参与受限空间进入许可？

shots.scene: 三组人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Three groups of person icons. No people.
shots.narration: 只有进入者？主管和安全员？再加监护人？

shots.scene: 第三组亮绿
shots.prompt_en: The third group lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：主管、安全员和授权监护人。

shots.scene: 人群拥挤、噪声、缺氧三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a crowd, a loud speaker and a low oxygen symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第九题：受限空间的主要风险之一？

shots.scene: 缺氧图标亮绿
shots.prompt_en: The low oxygen icon lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：缺氧。

shots.section_title: 连续监测，发现有毒气体
shots.scene: 检测仪一直挂在入口
shots.prompt_en: A gas detector hangs at the entry, monitoring continuously. No people.
shots.narration: 第十题：为什么要连续监测空气？
overlay: 连续监测，发现有毒气体

shots.section_title: 连续监测，发现有毒气体
shots.scene: 毒物、风扇、温度计三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a toxic cloud, a fan and a thermometer. No people.
shots.narration: 发现有毒物质？保证通风？监测温度？

shots.section_title: 连续监测，发现有毒气体
shots.scene: 毒物图标亮绿
shots.prompt_en: The toxic cloud icon lights up green. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：及时发现有毒物质。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 十题十分钟，答对八题才算过。

shots.scene: 救援三脚架和检测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a rescue tripod and a gas detector. No people.
shots.narration: 救援定期练，限值因物质而异。

shots.scene: 监护人和许可证图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an attendant and a permit form. No people.
shots.narration: 监护人盯人启动救援，许可多方参与。

shots.scene: 缺氧和毒物图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of low oxygen and a toxic cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 主要风险缺氧，连续监测有毒物质。

shots.scene: 欣欣在井口旁挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside the closed manhole.
shots.narration: 受限空间小测验到这里，下次见！
